rifleman.label: Rifleman
rifleman.blurb: U.S. Army rifleman armed with an M1 Garand service rifle.

mg.label: Machine Gunner
mg.blurb: Carries the M1918A2 Browning Automatic Rifle (BAR), the U.S. squad's automatic rifle. Heavy weapon, slower movement, and strong suppression.

medic.label: Medic
medic.blurb: Carries medical supplies and treats the nearest wounded soldier. Cannot revive or shoot in this game.

supply_officer.label: Supply Officer
supply_officer.blurb: Carries an M1 Garand and ammunition supplies. Refills riflemen, engineers and assault infantry with grenades, plus bazooka rockets and mortar bombs. Serves requests in order.

at.label: Anti-Tank
at.blurb: Carries an M1A1 Bazooka with four rockets and an M1 Garand for use when rockets run out. A Supply Officer refill restores bazooka fire. Slow rockets with splash are the answer to vehicles.

sniper.label: Sniper
sniper.blurb: Uses the M1903A4 Springfield sniper rifle with a telescopic sight. Long-range and precise against infantry; weak against armor. More accurate in daylight, less accurate at night unless the target is lit by a flare.

engineer.label: Combat Support Engineer
engineer.blurb: Carries a STEN Submachine Gun for close-range burst fire. Builds sandbags, trenches, bunkers, mortar pits, barbed wire and pontoon bridges, and lays mines.

radio_engineer.label: Combat Radio Engineer
radio_engineer.blurb: Carries a STEN Submachine Gun for close-range burst fire and operates the field radio. The only role that can call artillery strikes and air support.

officer.label: Officer
officer.blurb: Carries an M1 Garand. Keeps nearby soldiers' morale up and helps them recover from suppression faster.

mortarman.label: Mortarman
mortarman.blurb: Operates a U.S. M2 60 mm mortar with six bombs, switching to an M1 Garand when empty. A Supply Officer refill restores mortar fire. Fires an inaccurate bomb every 16 seconds while stationary. A mortar pit improves protection and reload time. Blast can hit friendlies.

gun_truck.label: Machine Gun Truck
gun_truck.blurb: An open-bed U.S. Army truck with a crew-served M1919 Browning machine gun. Travels twice as fast on roads as on open ground. Dangerous against infantry, but vulnerable to all fire.

scout.label: Scout
scout.blurb: Fast reconnaissance infantry. Spots concealed enemies within 420 and halves mortar scatter on observed targets. Can patrol; smoke and solid obstacles block observation.

heavy_mg.label: Heavy Machine Gun Crew
heavy_mg.blurb: Tripod M1919. Packs for 2 seconds before moving, deploys for 3 seconds, and covers a 70-degree arc. Turns and redeploys to engage flanking targets.

assault_infantry.label: Assault Infantry
assault_infantry.blurb: Thompson SMG and six grenades. Order into a hostile building to approach an entrance, clear occupants in close combat, then garrison. Vulnerable in the open.

at_gun.label: Anti-Tank Gun Crew
at_gun.blurb: 57 mm anti-tank gun. Packs for 3 seconds, deploys for 4 seconds and covers a 50-degree arc. Slow traverse; prioritizes vehicles. Cannot garrison buildings.
